name: Guided Tours at the Municipal Gallery
description: Gain deeper insight into the current exhibitions, including Silvestre Pestana's 'Collapse,' with guided tours in both Portuguese and English.
longDescription:
The Galeria Municipal do Porto offers guided tours on June 6, 2026, providing visitors with an opportunity to explore the current art displays in greater depth. These tours are designed to enhance understanding of the exhibited works, including the solo presentation by Silvestre Pestana titled 'Collapse.' The initiative aims to offer context and interpretation for the contemporary art pieces on view.

Attendees will participate in a structured walk-through of the gallery spaces, with commentary provided by knowledgeable guides. The tours are conducted in both Portuguese and English, accommodating a diverse audience interested in contemporary art. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is a dedicated exhibition space, presenting a focused environment for art appreciation.

Entry to the guided tours is included with gallery admission. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is located within walking distance of the Carolina Michaelis metro station.
